vb_textbox.text: To get the highest points you must pick the gnome of the group which has the highest yield. To do this you must recognise that there are two groups of which each one has 4 colours. Memorise the colours for each group, one group is- pink, red, orange and blue and the other group is- green, brown, purple and yellow. Sometimes the group with the highest yield will alternate so if you get low points(under 5 points) with one group (that had the highest yield) twice in a row switch to the other group. One group will not always be on the same side or correspond to the same letter and might switch to the other side/letter, be vigilant and have fun!
